## Head lice removal in Dighi: For children and adults, without the embarrassment.
Head lice are a common problem and can happen to anyone. There is nothing to be embarrassed about. Rama Makeover offers this service for children and adults. Call or WhatsApp us to ask how the service works and what it costs.
More about head lice removal
Ask about this service 9372448675
### A few facts about head lice
- Head lice are most common in young children and their families.
- They spread mainly through head-to-head contact. They can't jump or fly.
- Having them is not a sign of being unclean.
- Don't share combs, brushes or towels.
- If one person at home has them, check everyone you live with.
- Scratching can cause sores. If you're not sure it's lice, or treatment hasn't worked, ask a pharmacist or doctor.
Sources: NHS – Head lice and nits · CDC – Head lice

## रमा मेकओव्हर · दिघी, पुणे येथील ब्युटी पार्लर: सुंदर दिसा, स्वतःसारखे राहा.
विचारपूर्वक दिलेल्या ब्युटी सेवा, तुमच्यासाठी खास लूक आणि फक्त तुमच्यासाठी थोडा वेळ. दिघी, पुणे येथे, दत्त मंदिराजवळ.
दत्त मंदिराजवळ, दत्त नगर, दिघी दररोज सकाळी 10 ते रात्री 9

## दिघीत उवा काढण्याची सेवा: उवांची काळजी, कोणताही संकोच न ठेवता.
उवा होणे ही एक सामान्य समस्या आहे आणि ती कोणालाही होऊ शकते. त्यात लाज वाटण्यासारखे काहीच नाही. रमा मेकओव्हरमध्ये लहान मुले आणि मोठ्यांसाठी उवा काढण्याची सेवा उपलब्ध आहे. सेवा कशी केली जाते आणि शुल्क किती, हे फोनवर किंवा WhatsApp वर विचारा.
उवा काढण्याच्या सेवेबद्दल अधिक माहिती
उवा सेवेबद्दल विचारा 9372448675
### उवांबद्दल थोडी माहिती
- उवा लहान मुलांमध्ये आणि त्यांच्या कुटुंबात जास्त आढळतात.
- उवा मुख्यतः डोक्याचा डोक्याशी थेट संपर्क आल्याने पसरतात. त्या उडत किंवा उड्या मारत नाहीत.
- उवा होणे म्हणजे अस्वच्छता नव्हे.
- कंगवा, ब्रश आणि टॉवेल एकमेकांसोबत शेअर करू नका.
- घरातील एका व्यक्तीला उवा असतील, तर घरातील सर्वांचे डोके तपासा.
- खाजवल्याने डोक्यावर जखमा होऊ शकतात. उवाच आहेत याची खात्री नसेल, किंवा उपचारानंतरही फरक पडला नसेल, तर फार्मासिस्ट किंवा डॉक्टरांचा सल्ला घ्या.
स्रोत (इंग्रजी): NHS – Head lice and nits · CDC – Head lice

## Rama Makeover · Dighi, Pune: Head lice removal for children and adults.
Rama Makeover offers a head lice removal service for children and adults at our parlour in Datta Nagar, near Datta Mandir, Dighi (Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune). We're open every day from 10 am to 9 pm. Call or WhatsApp 9372448675 to ask how the service works, what it costs and when you can come in.
Ask about this service 9372448675
## Head lice care: Nothing to be embarrassed about.
Head lice are a common problem and can happen to anyone. There is nothing to be embarrassed about. Rama Makeover offers this service for children and adults. Call or WhatsApp us to ask how the service works and what it costs.
### A few facts about head lice
- Head lice are most common in young children and their families.
- They spread mainly through head-to-head contact. They can't jump or fly.
- Having them is not a sign of being unclean.
- Don't share combs, brushes or towels.
- If one person at home has them, check everyone you live with.
- Scratching can cause sores. If you're not sure it's lice, or treatment hasn't worked, ask a pharmacist or doctor.
Sources: NHS – Head lice and nits · CDC – Head lice
